IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long,
straight golden-blonde hair stands on a
garden path in front of a stone
colonnade. She wears a black
off-shoulder gown with a deep V
neckline and a structured bodice, a
layered gold choker, and large gold drop
earrings. Her expression is calm and
direct. Soft, late-afternoon daylight, a
palette of black, gold, and warm stone.
Classic and glamorous, in the style of a
1990s couture show photograph.
